title: 白马篇
author: 曹植
intro: A young rider on a white horse with a golden bridle gallops to the northwest frontier — a dazzling archer who will give his life for his country without a second thought. This is the poem that created the Chinese image of the youthful knight-errant.
analysis: 这首诗塑造了一个少年英雄。开头像电影镜头：一匹白马戴着金色的笼头，飞快地向西北奔去。“这是谁家的孩子？”原来是幽州、并州一带的游侠少年。接下来写他的本领：从小离家，在边疆出了名；箭法神准，左右开弓都能射中靶子，抬手能接住飞跳的猿猴，俯身能射碎箭靶，比猴子还灵活，像豹子一样勇猛。然后写形势紧急：边城告急，敌人的骑兵不断进犯，紧急军书从北方传来，他立刻策马登上高堤，冲进敌阵，打败匈奴和鲜卑。最后八句是他的内心独白：上了战场，生命就不再属于自己；父母都顾不上，更别说妻子儿女；名字已经写在壮士的名册上，就不能再想个人的事。最后两句“捐躯赴国难，视死忽如归”——为国家献出生命，把死看得像回家一样平常——成了千古名句。诗里大量用对偶（两句结构相同、意思相对），读起来节奏明快，充满力量。
analysisEn: This poem creates a young hero. It opens like a film shot: a white horse with a golden bridle racing toward the northwest. “Whose son is that?” A young knight-errant from Youzhou and Bingzhou, the tough northern borderlands. Then we see what he can do. He left home as a boy and made his name on the desert frontier. He shoots with either hand and never misses; he can reach up and catch a leaping monkey, or lean down from the saddle and shatter a target. He is quicker than an ape and fierce as a leopard. Then the crisis: the border town is under attack, enemy horsemen keep raiding, an urgent war dispatch arrives from the north. He spurs his horse up onto the high bank and charges, trampling the Xiongnu and crushing the Xianbei. The last eight lines are his own thoughts. Once you are on the battlefield, your life is no longer yours; he can’t even think of his parents, let alone a wife and children. His name is on the roll of soldiers, so private worries must go. The final couplet — “to give my life for my country in danger, and face death as if going home” — is still quoted today. Many lines are paired in parallel (two lines with the same structure), which gives the poem its quick, driving beat.
background: Cao Zhi (192–232), Cao Cao’s gifted younger son, was the most admired poet of his age. As a young man he hoped to win glory for his country; after his brother Cao Pi became emperor he was kept far from power and closely watched. This poem is usually seen as an expression of his early ambitions.
pronunciation: 幽并 bīng（并州，古地名）；少小 shào；楛矢 hù（一种木头做的箭杆）；参差 cēn cī；左的 dì（箭靶）；勇剽 piāo；豹螭 chī；数迁移 shuò（屡次）；羽檄 xí；中顾私 zhōng。虏骑：古代名词“骑”（骑兵）旧读 jì，统编教材现统一读 qí，网站按 qí 注音。“月支”是箭靶名，读 yuè zhī。
version: 采用《文选》卷二十七所收通行文本，全诗二十八句，网站一联一行（共十四行）。

lines.zh: 白马饰金羁，连翩西北驰。
lines.rhythm: 白马/饰金羁，连翩/西北驰
lines.py: bái mǎ shì jīn jī, lián piān xī běi chí
lines.lit: A white horse adorned with a golden bridle, gallops on and on toward the northwest.
lines.en: A white horse in a golden bridle flashes off toward the northwest.

lines.zh: 借问谁家子，幽并游侠儿。
lines.rhythm: 借问/谁家子，幽并/游侠儿
lines.py: jiè wèn shuí jiā zǐ, yōu bīng yóu xiá ér
lines.lit: May I ask whose son he is? A wandering knight from You and Bing.
lines.en: “Whose son is that?” — a young knight-errant from the northern borderlands.
lines.tts: 借问谁家子，幽兵游侠儿。

lines.zh: 少小去乡邑，扬声沙漠垂。
lines.rhythm: 少小/去乡邑，扬声/沙漠垂
lines.py: shào xiǎo qù xiāng yì, yáng shēng shā mò chuí
lines.lit: Young, he left his home town; he made his name at the desert’s edge.
lines.en: He left home as a boy and won his fame at the edge of the desert.

lines.zh: 宿昔秉良弓，楛矢何参差。
lines.rhythm: 宿昔/秉良弓，楛矢/何参差
lines.py: sù xī bǐng liáng gōng, hù shǐ hé cēn cī
lines.lit: Day and night he held a fine bow; his thorn-wood arrows, how uneven they stand!
lines.en: Day and night a good bow in his hand, a quiver bristling with arrows.
lines.tts: 宿昔秉良弓，户矢何参差。

lines.zh: 控弦破左的，右发摧月支。
lines.rhythm: 控弦/破左的，右发/摧月支
lines.py: kòng xián pò zuǒ dì, yòu fā cuī yuè zhī
lines.lit: Drawing the string, he splits the left target; shooting right, he smashes the yuezhi target.
lines.en: He draws and splits the target on his left, turns and shatters the one on his right.
lines.tts: 控弦破左地，右发摧月支。

lines.zh: 仰手接飞猱，俯身散马蹄。
lines.rhythm: 仰手/接飞猱，俯身/散马蹄
lines.py: yǎng shǒu jiē fēi náo, fǔ shēn sàn mǎ tí
lines.lit: Raising his hand, he meets a leaping monkey; bending down, he scatters the horse-hoof target.
lines.en: He shoots up to hit a leaping ape, leans down and blasts the low target apart.
lines.tts: 仰手接飞挠，俯身散马蹄。

lines.zh: 狡捷过猴猿，勇剽若豹螭。
lines.rhythm: 狡捷/过猴猿，勇剽/若豹螭
lines.py: jiǎo jié guò hóu yuán, yǒng piāo ruò bào chī
lines.lit: Nimble and quick beyond monkeys and apes; brave and fierce like leopards and dragons.
lines.en: Quicker than any monkey, fierce as a leopard or a dragon.
lines.tts: 狡捷过猴猿，勇飘若豹吃。

lines.zh: 边城多警急，虏骑数迁移。
lines.rhythm: 边城/多警急，虏骑/数迁移
lines.py: biān chéng duō jǐng jí, lǔ qí shuò qiān yí
lines.lit: The border towns have many alarms; the enemy horsemen often shift and move.
lines.en: Alarms keep coming from the border towns; enemy riders strike here, then there.
lines.tts: 边城多警急，虏骑硕迁移。

lines.zh: 羽檄从北来，厉马登高堤。
lines.rhythm: 羽檄/从北来，厉马/登高堤
lines.py: yǔ xí cóng běi lái, lì mǎ dēng gāo dī
lines.lit: A feathered war dispatch comes from the north; he urges his horse up the high bank.
lines.en: An urgent call to arms arrives from the north; he spurs his horse up the high embankment.
lines.tts: 羽席从北来，厉马登高堤。

lines.zh: 长驱蹈匈奴，左顾凌鲜卑。
lines.rhythm: 长驱/蹈匈奴，左顾/凌鲜卑
lines.py: cháng qū dǎo xiōng nú, zuǒ gù líng xiān bēi
lines.lit: Driving far, he tramples the Xiongnu; turning left, he crushes the Xianbei.
lines.en: He charges deep and tramples the Xiongnu, wheels left and overruns the Xianbei.

lines.zh: 弃身锋刃端，性命安可怀？
lines.rhythm: 弃身/锋刃端，性命/安可怀
lines.py: qì shēn fēng rèn duān, xìng mìng ān kě huái
lines.lit: Throwing his body onto the points of blades, how can he cherish his life?
lines.en: When you hurl yourself at the blades, how can you cling to your life?

lines.zh: 父母且不顾，何言子与妻！
lines.rhythm: 父母/且不顾，何言/子与妻
lines.py: fù mǔ qiě bù gù, hé yán zǐ yǔ qī
lines.lit: Even his parents he cannot care for — what to say of children and wife!
lines.en: I can’t even look after my parents — never mind a wife and children.

lines.zh: 名编壮士籍，不得中顾私。
lines.rhythm: 名编/壮士籍，不得/中顾私
lines.py: míng biān zhuàng shì jí, bù dé zhōng gù sī
lines.lit: His name is entered in the roll of soldiers; he may not think of private matters in his heart.
lines.en: My name is on the soldiers’ roll; there is no room in my heart for myself.

lines.zh: 捐躯赴国难，视死忽如归。
lines.rhythm: 捐躯/赴国难，视死/忽如归
lines.py: juān qū fù guó nàn, shì sǐ hū rú guī
lines.lit: Giving up his body, he rushes to the nation’s danger; he sees death, lightly, as going home.
lines.en: I give my life to meet my country’s danger, and face death as if I were going home.

words.note: 本义是马笼头；今天多用引申义“约束”，如“放荡不羁”。

words.en: on and on without a break (of fast movement)
words.note: 古语，今天常写作“联翩”，如“浮想联翩”。
古诗常用的发问语，现代汉语说“请问”。

words.en: Youzhou and Bingzhou, northern frontier regions
words.note: 并：读 bīng，古州名，在今山西一带，太原今天简称“并”。
仗义勇武、行走四方的人；现代汉语有“侠客”“武侠”。
少：读 shào，年轻；现代汉语有“少年”“男女老少”。
通“陲”，边疆，今天写作“边陲”。

words.en: arrows with shafts of thorn wood

words.note: 古义箭靶，今天仍在“目的”“有的放矢”里读 dì。
古义，读 shuò；今天常用的是 shù（数字）、shǔ（数数）。

words.en: urgent military dispatch with a feather attached
words.note: 插上羽毛表示紧急，像今天的“十万火急”。

words.en: the Xiongnu and the Xianbei, northern nomadic peoples
words.note: 古代北方的游牧民族，这里泛指入侵的敌人。
安：怎么、哪里，现代汉语说“怎么能”。
现代书面语仍用，如“为国捐躯”。
难：读 nàn，灾难；现代汉语仍说“国难当头”。

words.en: to face death as calmly as going home

imagery.name: 马
imagery.zh: 饰着金笼头的白马，是少年英雄英姿勃发的象征，全诗由它一路奔向边疆。
imagery.en: The white horse in its golden bridle sums up the young hero’s dash and pride, carrying the whole poem to the frontier.

imagery.name: 关
imagery.zh: 诗中的“边城”和“沙漠垂”是国家的边关，英雄的舞台和生死之地。
imagery.en: The border towns and the desert’s edge are the nation’s frontier — the hero’s stage, and where he may die.
